question: What power arises from always contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated.
The contemplation is to be done always.
Shaking the triple world is stated as the result.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: the object contemplated as smoke-colored may be the wheel, deity, or self
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
